scope: history-length-routed label-free temporal prior selected only on authorized development folds

search.formula: for sites meeting min history only: logit(current score) + weight * mean(site top-k current logits); otherwise current score unchanged

gates.selection: combined AP and recall improve, paired AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance
gates.confirmation: same fixed candidate has combined AP and recall improve, paired AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance

interpretation.hypothesis_source: transparent post-failure diagnosis found temporal priors help sites with sufficient history and hurt sparse sites
interpretation.parameter_selection: all cutoff/top-k/weight choices selected only on folds 2/3/4

invariants: History length, current scores, and physical grouping are available without labels at inference.
All 45 candidates, ranking, bootstrap seeds, and gates are frozen before development scoring.
Sparse sites are mathematically unchanged by a candidate route.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh-safety or paper replay.
